blocks.text: 30 December. Arrival in Rio de Janeiro

provenance.rationale: The approved Word Day 1 heading gives 30 December in Rio and the next line identifies arrival and transfer; joined as a concise itinerary heading.

blocks.text:
On arrival at the airport, you will be met and transferred to your hotel.

Even on the way, you will notice how Rio is preparing for New Year. Stages, lights, screens and loudspeakers are being installed on Copacabana Beach. More and more people wear white, and waterfront stalls sell white dresses and shirts, candles and flowers for New Year’s Eve.

After checking in, take a walk along Copacabana and the oceanfront. Its black-and-white mosaic promenade, neighbouring Ipanema and the warm Atlantic Ocean set the mood for the trip.

Restaurants in Ipanema and Leblon take bookings for New Year’s Eve well in advance. The city grows livelier, but your first evening is free: rest after the flight, enjoy a fresh juice or caipirinha and watch Rio prepare for the festivities.

The holiday spirit is already everywhere. In Ipanema and Leblon, waiters prepare special menus and coastal vendors display even more white clothing, flowers and candles. For Rio residents, preparations begin long before 31 December, so you become part of the celebrations before New Year’s Eve itself.
